title: A deleted gate witnesses changed evaluation
statement: Let $C$ be a layered circuit, let $w$ be a width threshold, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. If $C$ and its truncation retaining only first-layer gates of width at most $w$ have different values at $x$, then some omitted first-layer gate evaluates at $x$ to a value other than the neutral value of the dual of the first-layer gate type.
hypotheses_covered: An input x in the n-dimensional sign cube
The evaluations of C and its width truncation at x differ
